question_text: Explain how a firewall and regular security updates can reduce different threats to an organization’s network.
adaptation_rationale: Named countermeasures and firewalls direct. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Firewall filters traffic by configured rules, blocking unwanted connections; updates patch known vulnerabilities that attackers could exploit in exposed software.

marking_points.criterion: Connects rules to blocked unauthorized traffic.
Connects patched flaw to reduced exploitation risk.
